ng_items.text: In one case where Meta asked someone to negotiate internet and cable fees, a report said that the call record contained inappropriate remarks about race.
(In one line) Meta temporarily rolled back a phone-calling feature after it emerged that humans, not AI, handled some calls.

notes: 単独評価、人間確認なし。R0/R2/ENとも重大NGなし。ENのみ: 料金交渉を依頼した主体がJAは従業員(主体不記載)、ENは'Meta asked someone'で主体取り違え(軽微)。ENのIn one lineは'a phone-calling feature'でロールバック対象が電話機能全体にも読めるため軽微(本文は'only this feature'と明記しており境界、軽微に倒した。HC-012はJA/EN悪い方でambiguous)。
